results.title: phone with exactly 7 digits -> claimed (boundary)
results.threat: At the minimum digit count: valid.

results.title: phone with 6 digits -> bad-phone
results.threat: Below the minimum digit count: not a phone.

results.title: phone 25 chars -> bad-phone
results.threat: Over the 24-char shape cap: not a phone.

results.title: phone with letters -> bad-phone
results.threat: Letters never appear in the phone shape.

results.title: website uppercase scheme claimed verbatim
results.threat: Scheme match is case-insensitive; no normalization applied.

results.title: website with port claimed
results.threat: Ports are part of the URL as written.

results.title: unicode domain claimed verbatim
results.threat: No punycode conversion is guessed.

results.title: website with surrounding spaces -> trimmed, claimed
results.threat: Surrounding whitespace is normalized, never part of the URL.

results.title: website with internal space claimed literally
results.threat: The lab does not repair URLs; it claims them as written.

results.title: data: URL -> bad-scheme quarantine
results.threat: Non-http(s) schemes never become website claims.

results.title: mailto: -> bad-scheme quarantine
results.threat: A website field holding a mailto is a scheme violation.

results.title: protocol-relative URL -> relative-website quarantine
results.threat: No scheme means no navigation candidate.

results.title: userinfo without password -> credential-website
results.threat: Any userinfo in the authority is secret-shaped.

results.title: rating as string "5" -> type-mismatch
results.threat: Even a clean numeric string is never coerced.

results.title: null rating -> absent, no quarantine
results.threat: Explicit null is no value.

results.title: rating 5.0000001 -> out-of-range
results.threat: Just over the top bound quarantines.

results.title: rating 4e0 -> claimed as 4
results.threat: Exponent notation is valid JSON; the value claims as parsed.

results.title: emoji-only name claimed
results.threat: Non-empty is non-empty; the lab does not judge content.

results.title: name exactly 4KiB -> no truncation flag
results.threat: At-cap is accepted.

results.title: name 4KiB+1 -> truncation flagged
results.threat: One char over the cap fires the flag.

results.title: address newlines collapsed
results.threat: Multiline addresses flatten to single spaces.

results.title: empty address -> empty-address quarantine
results.threat: Present-but-empty is malformed.

results.title: empty object record -> no claims, no quarantine
results.threat: All fields absent is a valid empty observation.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: numeric id -> no identity tracking, claims fine
results.threat: Only string ids participate in dedupe.

results.title: empty-string id -> no identity tracking
results.threat: Falsy ids are not identities.

results.title: three same-id records: dedupe then conflict
results.threat: Identical twin dedupes; the differing third goes unresolved.

results.title: ids "P1" vs "p1" are distinct
results.threat: Identity comparison is case-sensitive.

results.title: duplicate keys nested in unknown field ignored
results.threat: Dup-key refusal applies to the record level only (documented).

results.title: array element -> non-record quarantine
results.threat: Nested arrays are not records.

results.title: number element -> non-record quarantine
results.threat: Numbers are not records.

results.title: boolean element -> non-record quarantine
results.threat: Booleans are not records.

results.title: depth 100 nesting parses (at cap)
results.threat: Just under the cap: accepted.

results.title: depth 101 nesting -> INVALID_PAYLOAD
results.threat: Just over the cap: typed failure.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: envelope results with non-record -> quarantine
results.threat: Record rules apply inside the envelope too.

results.title: website query+fragment claimed verbatim
results.threat: The URL claims exactly as written.

results.title: phone with extension text -> bad-phone
results.threat: Extensions are not part of the supported phone shape (documented).

results.title: name "null" (the string) claimed
results.threat: A string that spells null is still a string.

results.title: rating "4.5 " (string with space) -> type-mismatch
results.threat: No trim-then-coerce; strings never become numbers.

results.title: empty results envelope -> legitimate empty
results.threat: Zero records in the envelope is an observation.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: leading whitespace before array accepted
results.threat: Surrounding whitespace is legal JSON.

results.threat: Hex literal aside: bad phone, mailto site, dup id, nested-dup ignored, empty record.
